narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>A billion is a thousand million, so multiply six by three to get ten to the power eighteen.
<bookmark mark='adds'/>Multiplying by a thousand adds three zeroes. It does not triple them.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The exponent goes up by three, not times three, so the bubble is wrong.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 6 × 3 = 18; three zeroes join the end of 1,000,000; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Each new name multiplies by a thousand, so add three to the exponent.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. A sextillion is a thousand quintillion. What power of ten is it?
removed_beats.on_screen: the line each name adds 3 to the exponent appears; the word sextillion appears with an empty box
